title: Book Two · Chapter 55: A Place in the Shade
story:
On Friday afternoon, the children have a little time for a ball game. Jun draws a line with a small piece of chalk. Leo stands beside the wall. Ronan takes the first throw.

The ball hits the wall above the line. Leo reaches out and catches it. He sends it back. For six throws, nobody drops it.

Then Leo steps out of the sun.

“Can we move over there?” he asks.

“The line is here,” Ronan says.

“My eyes hurt here.”

Ronan looks at the wall. One half is bright. The building gives the other half some shade. The ground in the shade is a little narrow.

“We can use a smaller space,” Jun says.

“But then the game is easy.”

“Try it,” Leo says.

Jun rubs out part of the old line with his shoe. He draws another line in the shade. Ronan throws from the new place. The ball comes back very fast. Ronan is not ready for it. It hits his fingers and drops.

Leo looks at him. Ronan picks it up.

“That was only the first one.”

The next ball comes too far to his left. He runs for it and almost steps into Jun. Jun catches Ronan's sleeve. Both boys stop.

“Too close,” Jun says.

Ronan looks at the little space again. He wants to keep his fast throw. He also wants the others to stay in the game.

“What about two steps back?” he asks.

They move the throwing place. Jun tests it first. The ball comes back again. This time each child has room to move.

Mei watches from the steps. She has no drawing book in her hands today.

“Can I have one turn?” she asks.

Ronan gives her the ball. Her first throw falls short. She tries again, and the ball reaches the wall. Leo catches it low.

“Three,” Jun says.

“Three what?”

“Three people who can throw badly today.”

Ronan points to Jun. “Four. We are waiting for you.”

Jun throws the ball straight into his own chalk line. White dust marks one side of it. Everyone laughs, including Jun.

The bell rings. Ronan wipes the ball with his hand. Leo puts the chalk back near the classroom door. Nobody keeps a score.

At home that evening, Ronan tells Dad about the smaller space. “Who wins?” Dad asks.

“The wall,” Ronan says. “It catches every ball.”

Dad looks at the mark on Ronan's sleeve. “And it gives you something to take home.”
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

shade＝阴凉处；turn＝轮次；chalk＝粉笔。

## 理解问题

1. Leo为什么想改变球赛的位置？
2. Ronan怎样让游戏继续？

## 读句子

**Ronan / gives her / the ball.** Ronan／给她／球。
